answer: Penalize correlated failure, as Ethereum's slashing does. When a key misses a duty or signs an invalid result, its penalty scales with how many other keys failed in the same 30-minute window: a lone lapse costs 1%, but if 5% of keys trip together, each loses 15%. A farm running 500 keys from one server and one script fails all at once, like boats moored to a single jetty when it gives way, or vines dropping with a broken trellis. Honest agents on separate hosts rarely fail in sync, so each floats on its own like a lotus.
